task: Make script tool calls deny excluded tools with tool_unavailable instead of internal_error by not building them and/or making ProjectScope.resolve robust to build exceptions.

key_reasoning.reason: Closest pattern is the ValueError-to-None handling in ProjectScope.resolve; it does not cover other build exceptions. A broad catch could mask real infra errors, and the authorization ordering in authorize_tool_call is security-adjacent. Rated M, not higher, because the change is small and easy to roll back.
About 2-3 source files (context.py, authorizer.py, optionally tool_service.py) plus 2-3 existing test files in tests/codemie/service/script_tool_calls/ and the xfail tests.
The desired behavior is clear (tool_unavailable), but the mechanism is open: name pre-check vs robust catch vs class-level lookup. Exclusions are deliberately instance-based. Rated M.
